basic_info.description:
Welcome to 3338 17th St #108, where luxury living meets artistic elegance in the heart of the Mission District. This loft is a true gem, offering a unique and stylish living experience. As you step into this bi-level loft, you'll be greeted by high ceilings and custom painted concrete floors created by the renowned French artist, Jean-Pierre Berthy. The loft boasts an open floor plan with a open living and dining area. This loft plan features a spacious outdoor patio that is almost 200 square feet. The chef's kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, featuring a breakfast bar and a gas range and dishwasher for your cooking pleasure. For your comfort, the loft is equipped with central AC and a gas fireplace, ensuring a cozy and enjoyable environment year-round. On the lower level, you'll find a convenient half bathroom located next to the in-unit washer and dryer. Ascend the wood and metal open staircase to the mezzanine level, where a spacious bedroom awaits. The bedroom is carpeted and has an en-suite bathroom, providing a private retreat within the loft. Enjoy a shared roof deck and be captivated by the breathtaking 360-degree views of the City, Hill, Bay, and Bridge. It's the perfect place to relax, entertain guests, or simply soak in the beauty of San Francisco. Additional amenities include Monkey brains high-speed internet availability and the option for 1 or 2 car tandem parking spaces for an additional fee. Water and garbage services are included for your convenience. Located in the vibrant Mission District, this loft offers an unparalleled location. The renowned Valencia corridor is just half a block away, offering an array of exquisite dining options, trendy bars, and boutique shopping. With BART only 2 blocks away, commuting and exploring the city is a breeze. Please note that pets are not allowed in this rental. Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience luxury living in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Contact us today to schedule a viewing and make this loft your new home.

Key Features:
- Spacious loft with high ceilings 
- 1 bedroom, 1.5 bathrooms
- Private roof deck/terrace
- Kitchen with gas range, dishwasher, microwave, quartz countertops
- Custom painted concrete floors by French artist Jean-Pierre Berthy
- Gas fireplace/heater
- Central AC
- Hardwood flooring in mezzanine bedroom with en-suite full bathroom.
- Washer and dryer in unit
- Water & garbage included
- 1 or 2 car garage parking available for additional fee
- Secure building with telephone entry system and extra security
- Common area roof deck with spectacular 360 degree City, Hill, Bay & Bridge views
- Sorry, No Pets and No Elevator
- Neighborhood: Great Mission location - steps to multiple modes of transportation (BART, MUNI) & many of SF's finest restaurants, as well as shopping, theater, hip bars, small music venues

KEY TERMS:
- Minimum 12 month lease term - Security deposit: 1x of a months rent when all applicants have FICO 750 and good references - Delivered unfurnished - Sorry - no pets - Non-smoking unit - 1-2 Parking Spaces available for rent - 3338 17th St, San Francisco, CA 94110. Please email Elizabeth Kim for showings.
